entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
This is unbelievable. I've been waiting for five minutes. I want to return this piece of junk jersey right now!
Hello, thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. I'm sorry about the wait. How can I help you today?
You can help me by doing your job! I bought this ProFit jersey and it's completely useless. I want my money back. This whole experience has been a disaster.
I can certainly look into that return for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

A preference? Are you kidding me? It's the wrong size! It's so ridiculously too tight I can barely get it on. I need to exchange it or get a refund immediately. This is the last time I ever order from you.
I'm very sorry to hear the fit was not what you expected. I can understand your frustration. Let me pull up your order to see what we can do. Can I get your order number?
Ugh, fine. It's VF8675309. You better fix this or I'm lighting you up on every review site on the internet. Get me your manager if you can't handle it.

I'm confident I can resolve this for you. One moment while I review your order... Okay, I see the ProFit Jersey was delivered on December 21st, which was 19 days ago. Let me just confirm the policy for you.
Don't give me some runaround about policy. Just process the return.

No runaround, I have good news. Since this is a standard apparel item, it's covered by our 90-day return policy. You are well within the window, so I can absolutely process an exchange for a larger size or a full refund. Which would you prefer?
Finally! Someone with some sense. Just give me the refund. I'll buy a jersey somewhere else. What do I need to do?

Of course. I've just initiated that refund process. I'm sending an email to you right now with a prepaid return shipping label. Just pack the jersey, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse scans it in, the refund will be issued to your original payment method.
Fine. Make sure that email shows up.
You should receive it within the next few minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
